title: Ketamine — Pediatric RSI Induction
sources: Green SM et al. Ann Emerg Med 2011;57:449-61

changelog.change: Tier 1 verification: 1-2 mg/kg IV induction confirmed. Widened the IM note to 3-5 mg/kg to match common dissociative-dose references.

purpose: RSI induction agent. Preferred in shock and reactive airway disease (bronchodilator, haemodynamically supportive). Specifically preferred over etomidate in septic shock — etomidate causes adrenal suppression.

doses.notes: Onset ~1 min, duration ~10-15 min. IM route 3-5 mg/kg (dissociative dose) when there is no IV access.

contraindications: Known or suspected increased ICP is a relative caution (evidence now largely reassuring)
buildNote: Pair with the rocuronium / succinylcholine paralytic cards and the atropine premedication card as an RSI set.
